name: Atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome
value: Stool negative for Shiga toxin; ADAMTS13 activity not severely reduced; complement factor H deficient (or factor I / CD46 mutation). Biopsy: thick capillary walls with split, reduplicated GBM, concentric arteriolar thickening, scarring

name: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
value: Urgent plasma exchange to remove the autoantibody, replacing with fresh frozen plasma to restore working enzyme; recombinant ADAMTS13 can also supply the enzyme, mainly in the inherited form

name: Atherosclerotic renal artery stenosis
value: BP drugs and risk-factor control, plus a stent or surgical removal of the narrowed segment when it drives the BP: unlike the idiopathic majority of high BP (over 90%), this renovascular cause can be fixed

name: Sickle cell nephropathy
value: 22-year-old Black man with lifelong anemia and repeated admissions for bone and chest pain: gross hematuria for 2 days; he has always passed large volumes and wakes to urinate at night. BP 118/72. Urine osmolality 280 mOsm/kg after overnight fluid restriction. Creatinine 0.7 mg/dL.

name: Collapsing FSGS (HIV-associated)
value: 31-year-old Black man off antiretroviral therapy for 2 years (CD4 90/uL): 3 weeks of fast-worsening leg and scrotal swelling and frothy urine. UA 4+ protein, 24-h protein 14 g. Creatinine 1.2 rising to 3.4 mg/dL over 6 weeks.

name: Collapsing FSGS (HIV-associated)
value: Untreated retroviral infection with a low CD4 count, or certain drugs and microvascular injury; heavy proteinuria; the worst prognosis of the podocyte-scarring lesions
